thread:
Alex: Morning — quick async check. Yesterday: finished gw-rateguard PR (https://git.redwood/internal/PR/458). Blockers: noticed token misusage in /ingress route tests causing 429s in staging. Today: gonna open hotfix and ping for reviews. @Maria can you re-run auth smoke in staging after I deploy?

Maria: Thanks Alex. Re-run ✅ planned after noon. FYI I saw increased 429s tied to a subset of clients w/ long seq lengths. Might need a batching tweak.

Sasha: Quick note — I left comments on PR 458 about ttl handling in the KV cache. Small change, should be quick to address. Also, are we keeping the ratewindow at 60s or moving to 30s for the test canary?

Alex: @Sasha, I replied — keep 60s for now, reducing to 30s broke some bursty clients in prod canary last week. I'll add a config flag so we can toggle per-route.

Linda: Blocker: I'm blocked on the canary policy docs, need exact field names for the rollout config. Alex, can you paste a sample snippet?

Alex: Sure — snippet:
```
route:
  id: /ingress
  rate_limit:
    window_seconds: 60
    requests: 1200
    policy: 'burst_protect'
  auth_required: true
```
Will add it to the PR description.

Maria: deploy-bot reports staging canary failed 1 of 3 pods earlier — logs show JWT rotate error. @Linda maybe related to config var mismatch.

deploy-bot: [deployment] canary rollout for gateway/v2 started at 1755551500

Sasha: I can take the JWT rotate look after lunch. If it's env mismatch, quick patch.

Linda: Thx. Today: finish docs + open follow-up ticket for per-route batching heuristic. Also will sync w/ infra to adjust max_concurrent for the dedicated pools.

Alex: OK — I'll open the hotfix PR and tag @Sasha + @Maria for review. If staging smoke passes, let's roll to canary tonight. :thumbsup:

Maria: Sounds good. Heads-up: leaving at 5:30 PT but monitoring slack for the smoke-run. :coffee:

Sasha: Ping me in thread if deploy needs manual rollback; I can jump in. 

Alex: Closing notes: action items -> Alex hotfix PR, Maria run auth smoke after deploy, Sasha debug JWT rotate if fails, Linda publish docs + ticket. Thanks folks.
